brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Japanese basketball news thumbnail, one PNG, landscape 16:9, at least 1536 px wide (prefer 1536x864).

Create ONE finished thumbnail for バスケまとめ using the approved black-and-lime hand-ink sports editorial look shown earlier. This is a team analysis, not an individual performance headline.
Use a near-black #151A18 background, vivid lime #CCF43B brush strokes, warm ivory typography, strong ink hatching and dry-brush marks. Few visual elements, excellent small-thumbnail legibility, premium editorial composition. No photorealism.

Subject: ONE real professional player, Trey Kell III (トレイ・ケルIII), based on the official Utsunomiya Brex portrait viewed in this conversation. Draw a new stylized ink illustration, never paste the official photograph. Preserve these visible distinguishing traits: very short close-cropped black wavy hair with tapered sides and a precise rounded hairline; broad oval face, defined jaw, straight strong eyebrows and almond-shaped dark eyes; medium-width straight nose, full lips; neatly trimmed thin mustache and a distinct small chin goatee with otherwise mostly clean cheeks; tall powerful athletic build. Make the likeness recognizable in an expressive ink drawing with ivory/light gray highlights so the facial features remain visible.

Pose and composition: player occupies the right 40 percent, in a dynamic low forward driving step with torso turning slightly toward the viewer and head looking toward the left, holding an orange unbranded basketball near his right hip with his right hand in a plausible dribble-control motion. The other arm bends naturally for balance. Show the head, both hands, the entire ball, torso, and enough bent legs to convey motion, with safe space from edges. Plain ivory/dark basketball jersey and shorts with small lime trim, absolutely no logos, sponsor marks, jersey text or numbers. Do not copy the earlier sample's overhead shooting pose. A broad diagonal lime brush slash behind the athlete creates motion without clutter. No other people, no opponent, no specific arena, no scoreboards.

Text is the central message on the left 58 percent, with clear hierarchy, very bold Japanese sans-serif headline and selected rough brush accents. Render exactly the following Japanese strings; no extra words, no player name, no individual statistics:
Small top-left: "バスケまとめ"
Medium upper heading: "宇都宮"
Directly below it, smaller: "直近5試合分析"
Large central headline first line: "差がついたのは"
Largest central headline second line: "フリースロー"
Largest central headline third line: "と2P"
Footer, clearly readable and not cropped: "イラスト（AI生成）"
Next to that footer: "イメージ"

The team label must be unambiguous. No attribution of poor shooting, game appearances or other performance to the illustrated player. He was randomly selected from names in the fixed article. This is a symbolic basketball illustration, NOT a recreation of an actual game, a decisive shot, or evidence of return from injury. The only editorial premise is: Utsunomiya's last five games were analyzed, and free throws and two-pointers accounted for most of the point differential. Do not add rankings, scores, dates, invented data, injury statements or any additional text. Keep every heading, face, fingers and the full basketball inside the canvas. Human anatomy should be clean and believable. Visible AI label is mandatory. No official photos, team logos, league logos, watermarks or advertising.

ONE ALLOWED CORRECTION:
Edit image 1 (the generated black/lime basketball thumbnail) with ONE targeted correction: make the illustrated player's face and haircut more faithful to Trey Kell III in image 2, the official reference portrait. Image 2 is ONLY an identity/likeness reference, never a photo insert. Keep the existing unmistakably hand-drawn ink illustration style, body, pose, composition, ball, fingers, colors, text, footer, and all other elements of image 1 unchanged.

Critical identity corrections: his hair is very short close-cropped small waves, with closely tapered sides and a low nearly flat top; reduce the high, pronounced raised wave ridges of image 1. Use the official portrait's broad oval face, slightly rounder cheeks, precise jaw contour, medium-width straight nose, full lips, straight brows and dark almond eyes. His facial hair is a thin neat mustache and a small chin goatee beneath the lower lip and centered on chin. Cheeks and sides of jaw are mostly clean; remove the continuous dark beard along the jaw from image 1. Keep facial features legible, preserving the official reference's proportions while rendered with confident drawn ink marks, ivory highlights and limited gray tones. Do not make it a photo, trace a photographic texture, add sponsor marks, logos, text, or jersey number.

Preserve every existing Japanese text string verbatim and in the same position:
バスケまとめ
宇都宮
直近5試合分析
差がついたのは
フリースロー
と2P
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ

Do not put his name or individual performance in the image. It remains a team-analysis thumbnail and a symbolic basketball image, not a recreation of an actual game. Output one 16:9 PNG at the same or higher resolution as image 1.
brief.generator: OpenAI built-in image_gen (image_gen__imagegen). Initial generation plus one likeness correction; final output selected after visual QA. No external API or CLI generation.
